Reference Utilities

These helpers are useful when inspecting state, preparing execution scratch space, moving between CPU/GPU storage, or summarizing a domain after a run.

State Inspection

Chion.SnowpackModel.AbstractSnowpackDomain — Type
AbstractSnowpackDomain{NF}

Abstract supertype for array-backed snowpack state containers that expose the core layer arrays and auxiliary diagnostics used by the process kernels.

source
Chion.SnowpackModel.get_state — Function
get_state(domain, idx=1)

Return a dictionary snapshot for column idx of domain. Values are copied into plain Julia containers so callers can inspect state without mutating the domain.

source
Chion.SnowpackModel.print_state — Function
print_state(domain, idx=1)

Print a short formatted summary of column idx to standard output. This is a diagnostic convenience wrapper around get_state.

source
Chion.SnowpackModel.compute_auxiliary! — Function
compute_auxiliary!(args...)

Generic fallback for updating auxiliary diagnostics in-place. Concrete domain types override this when they expose derived state such as snow cover or surface albedo.

source
compute_auxiliary!(domain, idx)

Recompute derived diagnostics for column idx in-place. Currently this updates snow-cover fraction and surface albedo.

source
compute_auxiliary!(domain)

Recompute derived diagnostics for every column in domain. Mutates the domain’s auxiliary fields in-place and returns nothing.

source
Chion.SnowpackModel.variables — Function
variables(x)

Return a tuple describing the prognostic and auxiliary variables exposed by x. The generic fallback returns an empty tuple for objects that do not publish variable metadata.

source
variables(domain)

Return metadata describing the published prognostic and auxiliary fields of a snowpack domain.

source
Chion.SnowpackModel.column_count — Function
column_count(domain)

Return the number of snow columns stored in domain.

source

Domain Summaries And Backends

Chion.SnowpackModel.summarize_domain_state — Function
summarize_domain_state(domain; backend=:threads)

Allocate and return a named tuple of per-column summary arrays for domain. This is a convenience wrapper around summarize_domain_state!.

source
Chion.SnowpackModel.summarize_domain_state! — Function
summarize_domain_state!(thickness, wet_mass, bulk_density, base_mass, smb_ice, liquid_water, runoff, domain; backend=:threads)

Fill preallocated summary arrays with one-column diagnostics from domain. Outputs are column-wise totals or aggregates in SI-like model units, and the chosen backend controls whether the work runs on Julia threads or a KernelAbstractions kernel.

source
Chion.SnowpackModel.cpu_domain — Function
cpu_domain(domain)

Return a copy of domain adapted to CPU Array storage.

source
Chion.SnowpackModel.gpu_domain — Function
gpu_domain(domain)

Return a copy of domain adapted to CUDA.CuArray storage. Throws if CUDA is not functional in the current session.

source
Chion.SnowpackModel.cuda_available — Function
cuda_available()

Return true when CUDA is functional in the current Julia session. This does not allocate any device arrays; it only checks backend availability.

source
Chion.SnowpackModel.kernelabstractions_available — Function
kernelabstractions_available()

Report whether the package was built with KernelAbstractions support. This is currently always true because the module unconditionally depends on KernelAbstractions.

source

Workspaces And Timing

Chion.SnowpackModel.StepWorkspace — Type
StepWorkspace

Per-column scratch storage reused by step!, including temporary liquid-water buffers and the energy-solver workspace.

source
Chion.SnowpackModel.threaded_workspaces — Function
threaded_workspaces(domain)

Allocate one StepWorkspace per Julia thread for threaded batch stepping. Each workspace is intended to be reused in-place by a single thread.

source
Chion.SnowpackModel.ColumnarStepWorkspace — Type
ColumnarStepWorkspace

Column-major scratch storage that holds temporary state for every column in a batch run.

source
Chion.SnowpackModel.StepTimingStats — Type
StepTimingStats

Accumulator for profiling the major internal stages of step!.

source
Chion.SnowpackModel.add_timing! — Function
add_timing!(stats, key, dt_sec, count=1)

Accumulate dt_sec seconds under key inside stats and increment the call count by count. Mutates stats and returns dt_sec.

source
Chion.SnowpackModel.timing_rows — Function
timing_rows(stats)

Return (rows, total) summary data for a StepTimingStats. Each row contains the total time, invocation count, mean time, and percentage share for one timed stage.

source
Chion.SnowpackModel.print_timing_summary — Function
print_timing_summary(io, stats)

Write a human-readable table of accumulated step! stage timings to io. This is purely diagnostic and does not modify model state.

source
